_comment: NOVA TV application catalogue. Edit this file to add, remove, or reconfigure launcher entries. Compat statuses: verified | experimental | unavailable | untested. NOVA TV never stores credentials; browser-based services handle their own sign-in inside the external browser process.

applications.name: YouTube
applications.description: Search and play YouTube videos — no browser, native mpv playback
applications.compat_notes: Uses yt-dlp to fetch stream URLs, mpv for playback. 720p on Pi 3B+. Requires internet.

applications.name: Media
applications.description: Browse and play local video and audio files
applications.compat_notes: Plays via external player (mpv). Verify codecs on target hardware.

applications.name: Settings
applications.description: Display, network, input, and system configuration
applications.compat_notes: Built-in screen. Settings persist across reboots.

applications.name: YouTube
applications.compat_notes: Opens in external browser. Sign-in handled by the browser, not NOVA TV. Performance is limited on the Pi 3B+; 1080p playback may not be smooth.

applications.name: Prime Video
applications.description: Amazon Prime Video via web browser
applications.compat_notes: No native Android TV app on Pi 3B+. Widevine DRM support in Raspberry Pi OS browsers is limited; protected content may fail to play. Sign in within the browser only.

applications.name: JioHotstar
applications.compat_notes: No native app on Pi 3B+. Region and DRM restrictions may block playback in a browser. Sign in within the browser only.

applications.name: Google Search
applications.compat_notes: Opens in external browser. Works as a website; not optimised for D-pad navigation.

applications.name: Google Account
applications.description: Manage your Google account in the browser
applications.compat_notes: Account management in the browser. NOVA TV never requests or stores Google passwords.

applications.name: Google Play Store
applications.compat_notes: Google Play Store requires certified Android TV. Raspberry Pi OS cannot install or run it. Use the configured browser-based services instead.
